chunks: Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, who said:

Abu Abdullah عليه السلام was asked about a man who hired a wet nurse and entrusted his child to her. She disappeared with him for years, then came back with the child, and his mother claimed that she did not recognize him.
He عليه السلام said: “They have no right to do that, so they must accept him, for the wet nurse is trusted.”

key_terms.الظِّئْرُ مَأْمُونَةٌ: the wet nurse is deemed trusted
key_terms.ظِئْرًا: a wet nurse hired to suckle and care for a child
key_terms.فَغَابَتْ عَنْهُ بِهِ سِنِينَ: she was absent with the child for years

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a wet nurse disappears with a child and later returns claiming it is the same child?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a child returned by a hired wet nurse after a long absence. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام rules that the family may not reject the child merely on the mother’s claim of non-recognition, because the wet nurse is regarded as trustworthy in such a matter.
